original_test_intent: Verify both front USB2 connectors sustain 12-hour operation at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails without data, reconnect, controller or platform errors.
original_method: Map slots 1 and 2 to their tools, cables and shared/dedicated hub paths; preserve a timestamped baseline; control chamber humidity/dew point, cold-soak and apply measured +5% rails without overshoot; execute the approved simultaneous or sequential SST profile for 12 hours with per-port integrity, enumeration, resets/retries and controller events; warm safely above dew point, disconnect and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator connects both tools, controls dry cold chamber/high rails, supervises the run and performs safe warm-up.
required_inputs: Simultaneous-versus-sequential SST build/profile and integrity volume
Abort, warm-up, disconnect and restoration procedure
safety_requirements: Prevent condensation during cooling and warm-up
Use calibrated measurements and avoid high-rail overshoot
Abort on moisture risk, shared-hub instability, data mismatch or rail/thermal fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening or connector work
agent_execution_scope: May analyze per-port integrity/link and platform event artifacts
Must not manipulate connectors, chamber or rails and must not decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve dual-port topology, profile and limits
Review each connector and determine verdict
